environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no public IP, no IGW route). Traffic arrives exclusively through an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) with a target group health check on /api/v1/health. The NLB has no public-facing listener. Upstream connectivity is provided by a separate internet-facing ALB in a different account (shared services) that forwards to the NLB via AWS PrivateLink (VPC endpoint service). The ALB's security group restricts inbound to three specific CIDR ranges: 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.20.128.0/20 (partner API gateway NAT pool), and 192.168.44.0/24 (CI/CD runner subnet). Additionally, the VPC endpoint service has an endpoint policy that only allows connections from the three principal ARNs corresponding to the shared-services ALB account. The NLB's target group uses proxy protocol v2 to preserve source IP, and the ECS task's security group only allows ingress from the NLB's ENI security group. There is no path from the public internet to the service; all three CIDR ranges are RFC1918 private addresses routed through AWS Direct Connect or VPN tunnels with mutual TLS authentication at the tunnel endpoints.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, private subnet, no public IP
config.direct_connect: mutual TLS VPN tunnels for all allowed CIDRs
